sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dark moves and psychic moves are 1.5× stronger.
Solar Beam and Solar Blade also count as Fairy for type matchups.
Dark moves also count as Fairy for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Black Hole Eclipse, Comet Punch, Draco Meteor, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Light That Burns the Sky, Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom, Meteor Assault, Meteor Beam, Meteor Mash, Moongeist Beam, Searing Sunraze Smash, Spacial Rend, Sunsteel Strike, Swift, Tachyon Cutter, and Tera Starstorm: 2× stronger.

Aurora Beam, Blood Moon, Dazzling Gleam, Flash Cannon, Lumina Crash, Luster Purge, Mirror Shot, Moonblast, Night Daze, Night Slash, Photon Geyser, Prismatic Laser, Signal Beam, Solar Beam, and Techno Blast: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Dark-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Special Defense.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Light That Burns the Sky breaks the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Illuminate: Special Attack +2 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Special Attack +1 and receives a Wish.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
